# Home Central Stores

> Local hardware and building supplies destination in Owego, Vestal, and Candor, NY – tools, paint, lumber, contractor rewards, and more.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://www.hcinc.com/): Main landing page with weekly offers, categories, and featured products
- [Shop](https://www.hcinc.com/shop): Browse and purchase hardware, tools, and building supplies online
- [Shop Catalogue](https://www.hcinc.com/shop/catalogue): Full product catalog for hardware and building materials
- [About Us](https://www.hcinc.com/about-us): Company mission, values, and community contributions
- [Contact](https://www.hcinc.com/contact): Contact information, FAQs, and support for Owego, Vestal, and Candor, NY
- [Locations](https://www.hcinc.com/locations): Store locations and directions in Owego, Vestal, and Candor
- [Services](https://www.hcinc.com/services): Hardware and contractor services offered
- [Contractor Zone](https://www.hcinc.com/contractor-zone): Contractor rewards and professional programs
- [Special Ordering](https://www.hcinc.com/special-ordering): Custom and special order products
- [Paint](https://www.hcinc.com/paint): Paint products, color matching, and expertise
- [Owego Showroom](https://www.hcinc.com/owego-showroom): Owego store showroom information
- [Resources](https://www.hcinc.com/resources): Helpful guides and resources
- [Careers](https://www.hcinc.com/careers): Job openings and employment opportunities
- [Apply for Careers](https://www.hcinc.com/careers/apply): Job application form
- [Policies](https://www.hcinc.com/policies): Privacy, terms, and store policies
- [History](https://www.hcinc.com/history): Company history and milestones
- [Team](https://www.hcinc.com/team): Leadership and team members

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.hcinc.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexed pages
- [Robots](https://www.hcinc.com/robots.txt): Crawler access rules

## Context

Home Central Stores serves the Southern Tier of New York with three locations: Owego, Vestal, and Candor. We offer hardware, building supplies, tools, paint, lumber, contractor rewards, rental equipment, gift cards, and professional support. Product pages use dynamic routes (/product/[id]). Career listings use dynamic routes (/careers/[job_id]). Order tracking uses /order/[id]. The site is built with Next.js.
